subject.title: fix(mcp): forward isError status from plugin tool execution results

question: Should this MCP bug-fix PR be allowed to change root agent sandbox and TypeScript policy, or should those AGENTS.md edits be removed or split before merge?
rationale: Root AGENTS.md controls future agent behavior, and accepting a sandbox-workaround instruction is a maintainer security and automation policy choice outside the MCP runtime fix.

options.title: Remove AGENTS.md edits
options.body: Keep this PR narrowly scoped to MCP `isError` forwarding and require any root policy changes to go through a separate maintainer-reviewed PR.

options.title: Approve policy changes here
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the repository-wide agent-policy change in this PR, but that owns the sandbox and automation risk.

options.title: Split the policy work
options.body: Ask the contributor to move AGENTS.md changes into a separate PR with a policy-focused rationale and review path.

recommendation.title: Remove AGENTS.md edits
recommendation.body: Keep this PR narrowly scoped to MCP `isError` forwarding and require any root policy changes to go through a separate maintainer-reviewed PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the MCP handler surface and is also a plausible reviewer for whether root repository policy belongs in this PR.
